chunks: Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Qasrī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about istikhārah, so he said:
"Seek guidance from Allah in the last rakʿah of salat al-layl while you are in sajdah, one hundred and one times."
He said: "How should I say it?" He said:
"You say: Astakhīru Allāha bi-raḥmatihi, astakhīru Allāha bi-raḥmatihi."

key_terms.الِاسْتِخَارَةِ: seeking divine guidance from Allah regarding a matter

ai.seo_question: How should istikhārah be performed in the last rakʿah of the night prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a form of istikhārah to be performed during the final rakʿah of salat al-layl while in sajdah. It specifies both the number of repetitions and the wording of the supplication, emphasizing seeking Allah's guidance through His mercy.
